claims.statement: In the inherited unpaid nonzero-pivot B08 residual branch with e2(min(1,h_nu^2/gamma^2))>=2/3 and theta_{gamma/16}(H)<201/100, h_2>gamma/sqrt(2), sum_{nu>=3}mu_nu<329/12900, and ||H-H_2||_HS^2<(329/3218176)gamma^2; hence h_3/h_2<0.014300 whenever rank(H)>=3.

If the same branch also has the r19 two-sided ridge-coloop indices j,r with left/right leverage >99/100, the incident normalized exterior determinant bank exceeds 1067/2000 and lies within Frobenius distance <0.226568 of the single factorized exterior mode generated by the top two singular planes.

If rank(H)=2 in the inherited branch, account03/B06 exact-rank-two L3 cross-bank smoothing plus account04/B18 dependence-safe square smoothing give ||p_Q||_infinity<10.575/sqrt(|a| gamma). Absolute continuity and essential boundedness are proved; continuity is not claimed.
The unrestricted universal bounded-density conjecture and the full continuous-density conclusion remain open.
